name: Anchor
author: pedro
summary: Time PLAY and loop EXIT with live deck-status events from AZ-MODS 1.2.6.
description: Align a chosen point on B with an outgoing phrase, cue or grid boundary in the two-deck waveform view. Pick phrase starts, Hot Cues or Set here in Ribbon, Card or Sidebar. B targets stay fixed through beat jumps and loop changes. Anchor follows working loops even while B is paused when the SDK publishes their boundaries. Anchor is a read-only guide.
